notes:
Overview: Silverkeep operates regional control centers for potable water and wastewater systems across three states. Very high tolerance for regulation; primary asks are full on-prem/private deployment, air-gapped operations inside a SCIF for some workloads, and auditable cryptographic key lifecycle (HSM/KMS).

High-level customer priorities (verbatim & paraphrase):
- 'Cannot allow any PII/exfiltration outside our network' — security director call 2026-02-28.
- Must run inference inside physically segregated rooms for incident summarization and operator assistant.
- Audit trail retention (immutable) for 7 years for operator transcripts relating to incidents.

Technical requirements / constraints (collected from SE + infra):
- Deployment: private on-prem appliance + optional management channel that can be isolated; ability to run entirely offline (air-gapped) for sensitive clusters.
- Attestation: signed images, SBOM for all binaries; support for offline image signing workflow.
- Keys: HSM-backed key management (FIPS 140-2/3), ability to rotate keys without internet.
- Models: prefer open foundation models; must be able to pin a specific model version and rollback. No outbound model downloads without admin approval.
- Data: strict residency - logs and artifacts must remain in the cluster; audit logs immutable.
- Network: egress disabled for PoC; separate management plane reachable only via jump-host in SCIF.
- Performance: target latency for short chat flows <= 150ms p50, p95 <= 400ms for 32-token prompts; baseline throughput target 40-60 rps per cluster for peak ops.
- Efficiency: interested in quantized model profiles to reduce GPU footprint — Redwood Optimize suggestions required.
- Fallbacks: require automatic fallback to smaller nominal model on overload, but only if model variant is pre-approved and stored locally.

- 2026-02-14: NDA and MoU signed. (legal contact trace in drive)
